senses.gloss: घो॑ष m. indistinct noise, tumult, confused cries of a multitude, battle-cry, cries of victory, cries of woe or distress, any cry or sound, roar of animals, RV.; AV. &c.
the sound of a drum, of a conch-shell, of the Soma stones, of a carriage, &c., RV.; AV. &c.
the whizzing or whir of a bow-string [TBr. ii], crackling of fire [MBh. ix, 1334], singing in the ear [ŚBr. xiv]
the roaring of a storm, of thunder, of water, &c., RV.; AV.; Suśr.; Megh.
the sound of the recital of prayers, MBh.; R.; Mṛcch. x, 12
the sound of words spoken at a distance, ŚBr. ix
rumour, report (also personified, KātyŚr., Sch.), RV. x, 33, 1
a proclamation, SaddhP. iv
a sound (of speech), ChUp.; Suśr.

the soft sound heard in the articulation of the sonant consonants (ग्, घ्, ज्, झ्, ड्, ढ्, द्, ध्, ब्, भ्, ङ्, ञ्, ण्, न्, म्, य्, र्, ल्, व्, ह्), the vowels, and Anusvāra which with the Yamas of the first 10 of the soft consonants make up altogether 40 sounds (cf. अ-घ्˚), RPrāt. xiii, 5 f.; APrāt., Sch.; Pāṇ. i, 1, 9, Sch.
an ornament that makes a tinkling sound, BhP. x, 8, 22
a station of herdsmen, MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c. (ifc. cf. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 85)
(pl.) the inhabitants of a station of herdsmen, MBh. iv, 1152
a particular form of a temple, Hcat. ii, 1, 389
a musquito, L.
Luffa foetida or a similar plant, L.
N. of Śiva, MBh. xii, 10386
N. of a man (Sāy.), RV. i, 120, 5
of an Asura, Kāṭh. xxv, 8
of a prince of the Kāṇva dynasty, BhP. xii, 1, 16
of a son of Dakṣa's daughter Lambā, Hariv. 148 and 12480
of an Arhat, Buddh.
a common N. for a Kāya-stha or one of the writer caste, W.
घो॑ष m. pl. (g. धूमादि) N. of a people or country, VarBṛS. xiv, 2
घो॑ष m. n. brass, bell-metal, L.
घो॑ष , ˚षक, &c. See √ 1. घुष्.
घो॑षा f. Anethum Sowa, L.
= कर्कट-शृङ्गी, L.
N. of a daughter of Kakṣīvat, RV. i, 117, 7; 122, 5 (? Impv. √ घुष्), x, 40, 5 (cf. आत्म-, इन्द्र-, उच्चैर्-, &c.)
घोष—कृत् m. any one making a noise, ŚāṅkhŚr. xvii.
घोष—कोटि f. N. of the peak of a mountain (?).
घो॑ष—बुद्ध (घो॑ष्˚), mfn. made attentive by the sound, AV. v, 20, 5.
घोष—मति m. N. of a man, SaddhP. i.
घोष—यात्रा f. walk or procession to the stations of the herdsmen, MBh.
घोष—यात्रा—पर्वन् n. N. of iii, chapters 235-257.
घोष—वत् mfn. sounding, making a noise, Āp. i, 11, 8; MBh.; R. v; BhP. ii
sonant, uttered with the soft articulation called Ghoṣa, RPrāt.; ChUp.; ĀśvGṛ.; Gobh.; PārGṛ. i, 17, 2; Pāṇ., Sch.
घोष—वत् m. N. of a man, Buddh.
घोष—वती f. a peculiar kind of lute, Kathās. xi f., cxi.
घोष-वद्—आदि mfn. beginning with a sonant, Hir.
घोष—वर्ण m. a sonant letter, W.
घोष—वसु m. N. of a prince of the Kāṇva dynasty, VP. iv, 24, 10.
घोष—वृद्ध m. an elder at a station of herdsmen, Ragh. i, 45.
घोष—स्थली f. N. of a locality g. धूमादि (not in Gaṇap.)
घोषादि a Gaṇa of Pāṇ. vi, 2, 85.
घोषादी॑ See गो-षादी॑.
घो˚षादी॑ &c. See ib.
घोषक m. ifc. a crier, proclaimer (e.g. पटह-, q.v.)
the creeping plant Luffa foetida or a similar plant, L.
घोषकाकृति m. ‘resembling the Ghoṣaka plant’, N. of a plant (with white blossoms), L.
घोषण mfn. sounding, BhP. iv, 5, 6
घोषण n. proclaiming aloud, public announcement, R. v, 58, 18; Hit. (v.l.)
(ifc. Ragh. xii, 72)
घोषणा f. id., Mṛcch. x, 12 and 25; Pañcat.; Daś.; Kathās.
घोषणीय mfn. to be proclaimed aloud, RV. vi, 5, 6; Sāy.
घोषयित्नु m. a crier, proclaimer, herald, L.
a Brāhman, L.
the Koïl or Indian cuckoo, L.
घोषयित्नु See √ 1. घुष्.
घोषातकी f. the plant Śveta-ghoṣā, L.
घोषातकी &c. See ib.
घो॑षि mfn. sounding aloud, RV. vi, 5, 6
(see also s.v. √ 1. घुष्.)
घो॑षि &c. See ib.
घोषि॑न् mfn. sounding, noisy, AV.; ĀśvGṛ.; MBh.; Hariv.
(in Gr.) sonant, having the soft sound called Ghoṣa, RPrāt.
घो˚षि॑न् &c. See ib.
घोषि॑णी (इण्यस्), f. pl. N. of certain evil spirits (cf. AV. xi, 2, 31), ĀśvGṛ. iv, 8, 27 f.; ŚāṅkhGṛ. iii, 9, 1 (cf. ग्राम-घोषि॑न्.)
घोषित m. N. of a man, Divyāv.
घोषिल m. a hog, Npr.
N. of one of king Udayana's 3 ministers, Divyāv. xxxvi
xxxvii, 577 f.
घोष्टृ mfn. a proclaimer, AitĀr. iii, 2, 4, 19.
घोष्टृ—त्व n. the state of a proclaimer, ib., Sch.
घोष॑द् ‘money’ or ‘substance’ (Sch.) v.l. for गो-ष॑द्, q.v.
